name: DMToolkit
description:
# DMToolkit v1.6.0

A comprehensive DM automation suite for D&D 5E, optimized for the **D&D Beyond + Beyond20 + Roll20** workflow. 15 modules covering combat, conditions with duration tracking, concentration auto-detection, HP monitoring, XP tracking, session recaps, quest management, downtime activities, and session summaries.

## Key Features

* **Initiative Automation** — Roll all/NPCs/PCs, group rolls, SRD monster database (~200 creatures)
* **Condition Duration Tracking** — Apply conditions with round timers, auto-expire on turn change
* **Concentration Tracker** — Auto-detects from Beyond20, prompts CON saves on damage
* **HP Monitor** — Auto dead/unconscious markers, bloodied warnings, gray tint on NPC death
* **XP Tracker** — Auto-tally from kills with CR lookup, manual XP, session awards
* **Quest Tracker** — Persistent quest log with statuses, public board, handout generation
* **Downtime System** — 12 activity types with built-in mechanics (carousing, gambling, training, etc.)
* **Session Summary** — Compile recap, quests, XP, downtime into copyable text for Discord/AI

## Commands

`!combat` Initiative | `!condition` Conditions | `!conc` Concentration | `!xp` XP | `!recap` Recap | `!quest` Quests | `!downtime` Downtime | `!session` Summary | `!loot` Loot | `!dm` DM Screen | `!guide` Player Guide | `!setup` Session Setup | `!toolkit` Help & Config
